(4) The perspective shifts to a lower angle, showing a light-green carpeted floor with some white markings, and the man's black shoe briefly enters the bottom of the frame. (5) The camera returns to a frontal view of the man in the mirror as he continues his enthusiastic narration, gesturing towards the camera and the surrounding space. The overall environment is minimalist and high-end.
